name: Governed CAPEX Workbench
metaphor: Workflow pages, dense registers, right-side evidence drawers, work queue
primary_question: Which workflow page or register do I open to review the evidence and act?
strengths: Expert throughput, dense review, implementation clarity, accessibility, bulk operations
risks: Can feel conventional; causality can be hidden behind tables; novice users may not know where to start
best_for: budget/forecast tables, commitment chains, assumption matrices, interface registers, audit-heavy reviews

name: CAPEX State Atlas
metaphor: Project state map, node graph, timeline replay, risk branches, decision rooms
primary_question: Which part of project truth is unsupported, stale, risky, blocked, or decision-ready?
strengths: Causality, stale/reopen explanation, executive reasoning, dependency visibility
risks: Graph overload, implementation complexity, accessibility risk, slower bulk review without register backing
best_for: orientation, why/what-changed explanation, executive briefings, cross-dependency reasoning

name: CAPEX Playbook OS
metaphor: Adaptive governance protocols, readiness gates, handoffs, evidence packets, guided decision packets
primary_question: Which protocol is active, what blocks it, and what must happen next?
strengths: Next-action clarity, onboarding, standardization, mobile decision completion, handoff discipline
risks: Can become checklist theater or rigid wizard if not adaptive; may slow expert exploratory review
best_for: intake, readiness gates, procurement readiness, risk re-evaluation, handoffs, mobile approvals
